About Me

I am a cancer immunologist with an MSc in Medical Immunology from Mashhad University of Medical Sciences. From 2022 to 2026, I worked as a research assistant at the Shiraz Institute for Cancer Research, where I studied B and T cell responses in breast cancer and how T cells interact with stromal cells within the tumor microenvironment.

01 / Academic Trajectory

Research Experience & Education

Progressive specialization from clinical laboratory diagnostics to translational tumor immunology and primary human tissue immunophenotyping.

Research Appointments

Research Assistant

Institute for Cancer Research (ICR), Shiraz University of Medical Sciences

2022 – 2026

Conducted independent laboratory experimentation, multiparameter data analysis, scientific illustration, and manuscript preparation under senior oncology and immunology faculty.

  • Immune Profiling of Cancer Patients: Examined immune cell frequencies, surface receptor expression, regulatory checkpoints, and intracellular cytokine production in B, T, and NK cells from peripheral blood and tumor-draining lymph nodes (TDLNs) of breast cancer patients.
  • Cytokine Stimulation Assays: Investigated cytokine-mediated modulation of regulatory molecules, including Foxp3 induction in T cells and functional regulatory markers in human B-cell subsets.
  • Immune–Stromal Interactions: Evaluated how adipose-derived mesenchymal stromal cells (AD-MSCs) shape T-cell exhaustion phenotypes via TIM-3 upregulation independent of PD-1.
  • Glioblastoma Molecular Workflows: Cultured and passaged the U251 glioblastoma cell line; performed RNA extraction from GBM clinical tissue samples, RNA gel electrophoresis, and cDNA synthesis.
  • Mentoring & Teaching: Mentored incoming MSc students in flow cytometry, primary lymphocyte isolation, statistical analysis, and thesis writing.

Laboratory expertise & credentials

Laboratory Skills, Service & Credentials

Hands-on proficiency across cellular immunology, multiparameter flow cytometry, primary human tissue processing, and biostatistical visualization.

Flow Cytometry & Immunophenotyping

Surface and intracellular antibody staining, instrument setup, and 4-color compensation for multiparameter immunophenotyping of NK cells, B-cell subsets, and regulatory/exhausted T cells.

4-Color Compensation Intracellular Cytokines FlowJo

Cellular & Co-Culture Systems

Ficoll mononuclear cell isolation from peripheral blood and tumor-draining lymph nodes (TDLNs), AD-MSC isolation and characterization, direct immune–MSC co-cultures, conditioned-medium assays, and cryopreservation.

U251 • Jurkat • MCF-7 MDA-MB-231 • A549 Raji • K562 • RPMI-2650

Molecular & In Vivo Training

RNA extraction from clinical GBM tissue, RNA gel electrophoresis, cDNA synthesis, qRT-PCR, immunohistochemistry (IHC), cell cycle, apoptosis, and MTT viability assays.

Certified Animal Lab Training: Ethical Considerations, Necropsy, Sampling & Handling of Mice, Rats & Hamsters (SUMS, Sep 2026).

Biostatistics & Scientific Figures

Statistical analysis, immunophenotyping gating strategies, and publication-grade scientific illustrations.
